theme_book.name: Wall paint on lime plaster
theme_book.spec: Limewash, clay paint or mineral silicate. Vapour-open, matt.
theme_book.reject_if: Any vinyl or acrylic emulsion. Anything sold as wipeable.
theme_book.rationale: A solid wall dries inwards, and a paint film that does not breathe undoes the replastering.

theme_book.name: Living and bedroom lamps
theme_book.spec: 2700K, CRI 90 or above, dimmable, trailing-edge compatible.
theme_book.reject_if: Anything at or above 3000K in a living room. CRI below 90.
theme_book.rationale: At CRI 80 the red in the brick goes grey.
